description: TaintTrail guard: records prompts, tool calls and tool results in the project's graph, and denies or asks before a call that would complete an attack path. Needs the `tainttrail` command on PATH.

hooks.command: command -v tainttrail >/dev/null 2>&1 || printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage": "TaintTrail plugin: the tainttrail command is not on PATH, so this session is NOT guarded. Install it as the plugin README says, then start a new session."}'
